payload.note: Pitch-over and the camera ladder (T13c/T15/T16/T30/T31). A flight is now a phase machine: ascent (physics replay) → gravity turn → Earth orbit → dotted transfer arc → lunar orbit → cargo drop → return → parachute, cross-fading between camera views so each mission zooms out one step and the Moon zooms back in. Budgets per mission: 10 s at mission 1, 21 s for the full Moon round trip, under the 30 s cap. The ladder re-scales: altitude, then distance to the Moon, then population toward 10,000. Zero console errors, 60–61 fps, sim PASS.
